title: Rank-zero chart coefficient normalization
statement: For the rank-zero chart a over an open V with a≫π=V.ι, the pullback compositor for a and π, evaluated at the constant unit, followed by vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient, equals ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback along V.ι. All maps are the specified comparisons of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts] and [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]; no normalized projective-line data is needed.

proof.text: Expand the zero recursive coefficient comparisons. Combine the inverse chart/projection compositor, equality transport for the chart square, and identity/open compositor into the two compositors with common composite V.ι. Cancel the leading inverse compositor. Naturality of the pullback identity comparison moves the unit pullback map through it; the canonical left pullback unit law cancels the remaining compositor. See the complete proof in words in the Lean docstring.

theorem vectorIntegration_chartCoefficient_zero
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 0]
    (V : S.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S 0 F V)
    (hc : vectorIntegrationChart S 0 F V e ≫ VectorBundleZeroSection.π S 0 F = V.ι) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (vectorIntegrationChart S 0 F V e) (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S 0 F)
        V.ι hc.symm).hom.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≫
      (vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient A N hA t S hS 0 F V e).hom =
        (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A V.ι).hom
